subject: Scanned adverse event form - patient reaction to Verolan
bodyText:
To Whom It May Concern,

Attached is a scan of a hand-completed adverse event report form from one of our field
nurses. Our outreach clinic does not have digital intake terminals, so all reports from
this site are completed on paper and scanned before submission.

The form describes a 57-year-old female patient who developed a rash and mild swelling
after starting Drug "Verolan." The handwriting on this particular form is clear and
legible throughout.

Please process at your earliest convenience.

Records Office
Rural Health Post
